ideas.pitch: An automated step-by-step visualizer for complex graph and dynamic programming algorithms tailored specifically to debug GFG and competitive programming problem statements.
ideas.title: CP-Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the core pain point of competitive programmers who struggle to debug intricate DP states or graph traversals under time pressure.

ideas.pitch: A terminal-based local testing utility that fetches test cases directly from online judge problem statements and runs automated stress tests against brute-force solutions.
ideas.title: Algorun-CLI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Speeds up the debugging workflow for solo competitive programmers during short-format timed contests.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight browser extension that parses competitive programming problem constraints and predicts optimal time complexities and potential bottleneck data structures.
ideas.title: CodeLens-CP
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aids algorithmic thinking and helps contestants quickly identify expected constraints versus chosen approaches.

ideas.pitch: A semantic search engine for classic competitive programming problem templates and editorials using custom vector embeddings.
ideas.title: CP-Archive-Search
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the problem of recalling exact algorithmic templates and standard problem patterns during intense contests.

ideas.pitch: An automated timer and leaderboard strategy tracker that calculates optimal time allocation per problem based on live difficulty distribution.
ideas.title: Contest-Pacing-Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets the strategic time-management aspect that determines success in short 135-minute competitive programming contests.
